title: Snapshot archive directory can be redirected outside the workspace
description: createSnapshot/listSnapshots/showSnapshot join .boreal/snapshots directly and do not route the directory through the workspace realpath guard used by export paths. A symlinked snapshots directory can write export baselines outside the workspace or read external attacker-controlled JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: Snapshot create/list/show route snapshot paths through workspace lexical and realpath boundary checks.
Symlinked .boreal/snapshots escapes are rejected before write or read.
Regression tests cover create, list, and show with an escaping snapshots symlink.
